title: An equivalent plan costs less
hook: Two stated cases: explore the horizon of avoidable plan costs.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the horizon of avoidable plan costs affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Saving, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the horizon of avoidable plan costs in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
